Lines.Speaker: Narrator
Lines.Text: ACT VIII — THE IRON TITHE. Fleet Log: the fleet holds at the outer marker of Tithe Anchorage. Commander Vance's main body withdrew here from the Cinder Archive.

Lines.Speaker: VexAI
Lines.Text: Captain, the Anchorage lies in the ring gap of the gas giant Grieve. It was a Tithe listening post on this side of the Arch long before the Arch was opened.

Lines.Speaker: TalaVane
Lines.Text: Forty hulls, Captain, and whatever Ithane sold him. He has had time to dig in.

Lines.Speaker: JaxMercer
Lines.Text: And every one of those hulls is carrying Severant spikes by now. He said so himself.

Lines.Speaker: VexAI
Lines.Text: The marker is transmitting. It is addressed to the Key-Bearer by name.

Lines.Speaker: Narrator
Lines.Text: Fleet Log. The Tithe Anchorage marker transmits on every channel the fleet can hear. Report ends.

BackgroundOverride.OutcastCorsair: And bring back what you took from my vault, thief.

Lines.Speaker: Narrator
Lines.Text: Fleet Log. Rustmarch: a shattered planetoid belt around a small orange star. Ore-rich, unclaimed, and untouched by the Tithe. Report ends.

Lines.Speaker: Cormaker
Lines.Text: Look at it, Captain. Iron you can cut with a hand torch, and nobody's name on any of it.

Lines.Speaker: Narrator
Lines.Text: Fleet Log. The Toll Line: the Iron Tithe's old blockade. Derelict toll platforms hold station among live mines. Report ends.

Lines.Speaker: VexAI
Lines.Text: Mine density is high around every lane out of here, Captain. A charted route would avoid most of them.

Lines.Speaker: Narrator
Lines.Text: Fleet Log. Seren Vael, the last living Severant world. Salt flats, white stone, and a harmonic ring that flickers when the Silence spikes. Report ends.

Lines.Speaker: Lyra
Lines.Text: The Choirs are singing, Captain. All of them at once. I have never heard it from outside.

Lines.Speaker: Narrator
Lines.Text: Fleet Log. Orbit of Cauter, Grieve's volcanic moon. The Graft Forge is anchored to the surface by three cables. Report ends.

Lines.Speaker: JaxMercer
Lines.Text: Tithe slabs outside, Severant ceramic inside. Two cultures bolted together, and the middle of it is growing spikes.

Lines.Speaker: Narrator
Lines.Text: Fleet Log. Tithe Anchorage is in sight. The Remnant holds forty hulls and an empty dock cut to the Dreadnought's dimensions. Commander Vance has prepared a berth for this ship. Report ends.

Lines.Speaker: VexAI
Lines.Text: The Anchorage's guns are grafted, Captain. We cannot close on it while the Graft Forge supplies them.

Lines.Speaker: TalaVane
Lines.Text: The forge is dealt with. The Anchorage is open to us.

Lines.Speaker: VexAI
Lines.Text: The Toll Line picket is destroyed. The lane to Grieve is open.

Lines.Speaker: CommanderVance
Lines.Text: You broke a blockade that kept you alive, Key-Bearer. You will understand that eventually.

Lines.Speaker: VexAI
Lines.Text: The Graft Forge engagement is concluded.

Lines.Speaker: JaxMercer
Lines.Text: The crucible is ours. Give me a watch and the Dreadnought shrugs off their pulses.

Lines.Speaker: ArisThorne
Lines.Text: There are Tithe crews down there with spikes grown into their hulls and their lungs. Captain, they need treatment.

Lines.Speaker: VexAI
Lines.Text: The Writ of Sector 7 is disabled. Commander Vance has been taken aboard under guard.

Lines.Speaker: TalaVane
Lines.Text: Captain, the prison block is open. Coalition crews. Some of them have been here since the border wars.

Lines.Speaker: CommanderVance
Lines.Text: Key-Bearer. I would like to speak to you before you decide anything.

Lines.Speaker: VexAI
Lines.Text: Captain, the vault holds a Precursor seal-key bearing the Coalition sigil. It matches the plate pattern of Gate Zero. Commander Vance kept it under three locks and no inventory.

Lines.Speaker: TalaVane
Lines.Text: We lost that key at Halden Reach. I was there.

Lines.Speaker: VexAI
Lines.Text: The vault is empty, Captain. Its record lists one item, removed in the frontier wars.

Lines.Speaker: CommanderVance
Lines.Text: Your Coalition took back what we kept safe. Look where it brought you, Vanguard.

Lines.Speaker: VexAI
Lines.Text: The vault is empty, Captain. The lock was cut from outside, years ago.

Lines.Speaker: CommanderVance
Lines.Text: Every miner in Sector 7 knew that story. I never knew it was you.

Lines.Speaker: TalaVane
Lines.Text: Captain, Remnant drive signatures on top of us. The pursuit clock ran out.

Lines.Speaker: CommanderVance
Lines.Text: You are inside my sector now, Key-Bearer. Every lane here was built to be watched.

Lines.Speaker: VexAI
Lines.Text: The Remnant raiders have withdrawn toward Grieve.
